releaseNotes: Home now shows your library properly: Recently added means recently added, category rails follow what you actually watch, and live channels you watch reach Home. Redesigned player controls. Fixes a serious problem where a failed sync could leave your catalogue empty, and stops long syncs freezing the rest of the app. Also: startup logo no longer clipped, episodes no longer badged MOVIE, and the player controls no longer hide while you are navigating them.
